intro: Kyrgyzstan is a presidential republic, after a 2021 referendum strengthened the president's powers.

chapters.title: How it works
text: President Sadyr Japarov came to power after the 2020 protests. Parliament, the Jogorku Kenesh, has 90 members.

chapters.title: Freedoms
text: Kyrgyzstan was once seen as the most open country in Central Asia, but press freedom has been reduced in recent years.
